Budget 2026-27 TRU letter: 'Chapter 57-65: No Change'. Confirmed by direct observation: the same 25 HS-6 codes are present at BOTH the Mar-2019 (ITC(HS)-2017) and Apr-2024 (ITC(HS)-2022) vintages.
economic_similarity: HIGH - a finished, manufactured, discretionary consumer durable sold into OECD retail. The closest available structural analogue among non-PLI categories to air conditioners (B3) and consumer electronics (B1).
export_scale: Large, long-established Indian export line - thick enough to model, with pre-2018 history available if the long-window forecasting route is ever taken.
historical_trend: Long stable history, no known policy break over the study window.
common_macro_shock_exposure: HIGH - global retail demand, container freight rates, rupee, and a comparable COVID collapse and rebound as a discretionary retail-channel good.
absence_from_pli: CONFIRMED ABSENT from the official 14 PLI sectors.
known_idiosyncratic_risks: (1) CHINA+1 SOURCING REALLOCATION - footwear is among the categories most affected by the global shift away from Chinese sourcing. This cuts both ways: it is a SHARED shock that a control should absorb, but it also means footwear is partially treated by the same reallocation the design tries to net out. THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT LIMITATION OF C2 AND MUST BE STATED IN THE REPORT. (2) Different secular growth regime - footwear grows slowly while mobile assembly scaled rapidly; the control matches shock exposure, not growth rate. (3) Indian Quality Control Orders covering footwear - primarily import-facing standards but may have affected domestic producers; DATES AND SCOPE NOT VERIFIED, flagged as a check. (4) More labour-intensive than the treated sectors, so more exposed to lockdown labour disruption.

historical_trend: Long stable history; India's traditional textile strength.
common_macro_shock_exposure: IDENTICAL - global apparel and home-textile demand, input prices, rupee, freight.
absence_from_pli: CONFIRMED ABSENT. The PLI Scheme for Textiles covers ONLY MMF apparel, MMF fabrics and 10 segments of technical textiles. Cotton is outside the scheme by the scheme's own fibre boundary.
known_idiosyncratic_risks: Cotton-specific input price shocks not shared with MMF - the 2021-22 global cotton price spike and India's April 2022 cotton import-duty exemption. Must be stated.

pre_registration_note: STRONGEST CONTROL IN THE DESIGN - a genuine within-industry comparator defined by the scheme's own fibre boundary. Narrowed 29-Aug-2026 from all of Chapter 52 plus cotton apparel to cotton WOVEN FABRICS only, so that it is matched to B4 on value-chain stage as well as fibre. The narrowing also removes the Chapter 62 discontinuity from the control set entirely. Selected and narrowed with NO treatment result computed or observed.

There is NO credible within-industry control for mobile phones. Every adjacent electronics assembly category is either directly PLI-covered (mobile components, IT hardware, telecom equipment) or PLI-adjacent through the same component ecosystem and the same Phased Manufacturing Programme tariff changes. C1, C2 and C3 are general comparators, NOT industry matches, and the B1 comparison is weaker for it. This must be stated in the report as a limitation of the headline sector, not papered over.
